info.title: dydo
info.description: Documentation, native skill authoring, and guardrails for AI coding assistants.

arguments.name: PROJECT

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Remove linked worktrees safely: archive uncommitted work, keep unmerged branches. Busy-worktree detection: Windows and Linux only.

options.name: --all
options.description: Every linked worktree of this repository [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would happen, including what would be archived; change nothing [default: False]

options.name: --archive
options.description: List the clean archive's entries [default: False]

arguments.name: WORKTREE
arguments.description: Linked worktree to remove, by path or branch name

commands.name: pr-ready
commands.description: Check a PR can be opened: clean tree, HEAD equal to its upstream, and with --body a ticket key and PASS review

options.name: --body
options.description: PR body file that must name its ticket and hold the reviewer's PASS block

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The tree to check (default: the current directory)

commands.name: merge
commands.description: Merge a reviewed PR into its feature/* branch with a merge commit; master, main and the default branch are refused

options.name: --match-head-commit
options.description: Required: the full 40-character SHA the reviewer passed; the PR head must equal it, and it is what merges

options.name: --match-base-commit
options.description: Required: the full 40-character SHA of the target branch tip you pinned; the PR's base branch must be at it, or nothing merges. It only refuses; it never selects the target

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Run every read and check; merge nothing [default: False]
